---
title: "FDR and Differential Expression"
---

## Core Question

What does FDR control, and how do normalization, variance, and testing interact?

## Lesson Scaffold

- Define false discovery proportion and FDR.
- Present the Benjamini-Hochberg step-up procedure.
- Use sorted p-values for graphical interpretation.
- State independence and positive-dependence assumptions at a high level.
- Use a simulated gene-expression experiment.
- Contrast effect size and p-value.
- Introduce volcano plots conceptually.
- Connect validation and reproducibility to projects.
